escenarios.desc: Take off, reach a point, hold still and take a photo that passes the quality test. The basis of everything.
Several photos in a row around the subject: the same plan, repeated with a for.
Fly through a series of rings: so it doesn't forget to move fast and precisely.
escenarios.trabajos: Precision training (no jobs for this yet)

escenarios.desc: Follow a camera path (static, orbit, reveal) with the house centered, without losing it.
Reach the goal dodging columns: it learns not to crash.
The same shots with wind gusts: hold on without losing the framing.
Film with poles a meter and a half from the path: real precision.
